name: LLMCheck: Apple M3 Ultra (512GB), LM Studio, GLM 5.2 753B-A40B IQ1_S decode
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LLMCheck open dataset). M3 Ultra 512GB, LM Studio, GLM 5.2 753B-A40B at IQ1_S (extreme ~1.7-bit quant), TTFT 1.5 s, per-request decode.
notes: Extreme-quant data point: a 753B MoE only fits at IQ1_S on 512GB, and still decodes at reading speed (22 tok/s). The Q4_K_M MLX row for the same model is 15 tok/s — recorded separately. Note quant IQ1_S has no dedicated quantization record in the repo.
